description: Decided in defk-dtw.15. report/1 takes optional native: (timing + package/version label), responsiveness: (max and p99 1 ms tick gap per side), realistic_size: and sweep: (sizes, times, crossover) keys; DEFK_RESULT JSON carries them so the verdict's workload-results snapshot is generated from run_all.exs output. Move bench/tick_gap.exs's method into a shared helper (one scheduler online, 1 ms ticker, implementation at the large size) so all six scripts measure identically. Done when: an existing example uses each key, run_all.exs prints them, and the snapshot table can be generated from its output.
title: Extend Defk.Bench.report/1 for target workloads
